prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: clear reference illustration for Chinese primary-school students designing a magic-brush grain mill.
Create one landscape 3:2 composition, approximately 1536x1024, on a warm pale handmade-paper background. Depict a small, mechanically plausible, hand-cranked wooden geared stone grain mill as a single coherent object in a clean three-quarter elevated view.
A compact dark natural-wood support frame carries TWO wooden spur gears of clearly different diameters, a smaller driving gear with a hand crank and a larger driven gear. Their teeth are evenly spaced. The two gears sit on parallel VERTICAL shafts, so both gears lie in the SAME horizontal plane and mesh at ONE visible contact point between their outer edges. Show the complete circular contours and the meshing area clearly. They must not overlap or pass through each other. Do not specify or label tooth counts.
The large gear's vertical shaft continues downward into the upper rotating round stone of a pair of gray millstones. Below the gears is the round stone mill; beside its central opening, a small wooden hopper of golden wheat feeds down through a short simple chute. A small flour outlet faces forward toward a woven collection basket with a modest pile of white flour. A few scattered wheat stalks rest beside the frame. The wooden crank should clearly turn the SMALL gear, with a comfortably visible horizontal handle above that gear. Separate all visible parts enough for children to follow the path from hand crank through small gear to large gear and stone.
Style: beautiful dimensional Chinese picture-book paper relief, delicate fibrous paper textures, muted mineral malachite and turquoise accents, warm brown wood, stone gray, restrained fine pale-gold decorative edging. Soft natural shadows establish depth and craftsmanship. Clean object silhouette; ample blank paper around all sides, the entire mill in frame. Warm and inviting, visually refined, not toyish plastic, not photorealistic.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no letters, no numerals, no text, no labels, no arrows, no diagrams overlaid, no interface cards, no panel borders, no logos or watermark. No additional gears, no motor, no belt, no waterwheel. Avoid tangling shafts, impossible gear intersections, missing teeth or floating components.
role: Artistic observation reference. Exact gear tooth counts and execution belong to the program's accurate interactive model.
visualReview: Passed: small driving wheel and larger driven wheel visibly mesh on parallel shafts, small-wheel crank, wood frame, millstones, grain hopper and flour basket; warm paper, mineral green/gold accents; no people, text or labels
